item.title: Siemens Unveils Digital Twin Composer
item.description: Digital Twin Composer enables industrial companies to combine 2D and 3D digital twin data from Siemens’ comprehensive digital twin with physical real-time information in a managed, secure real-time photorealistic visual scene.

item.title: Sous Vide Offers Brand Flexibility While Enhancing Taste
item.description: Sous vide cooking offers precise time and temperature control, and now companies are scaling this technology to help brands and institutions deliver on limited-time offerings. Taste wins with sous vide, and companies are employing new pasteurization techniques to retain flavor and expand into food segments, such as pet food, protein and overall clean label eating.

item.title: 2026 IPPE to Offer Real-World Solutions for Meat, Poultry Industries
item.description: The 2026 edition will feature the largest trade show floor in its history, with more than 665,000 sq. ft. of exhibit space and more than 1,380 exhibitors.

item.title: FOOD ENGINEERING Names 2026 Plant of the Year
item.description: CJ Schwan’s partnered with Burns & McDonnell to design and build a 400,000-sq.-ft. greenfield pizza manufacturing facility and 140,000-sq.-ft., fully automated distribution center with independent utility systems.

item.title: Califia Farms Debuts Simple & Organic Soymilk
item.description: Califia Farms’ first soy milk product is joined by new almond creamers and an updated lineup of core plant-based creamer offerings.

item.title: How PEZ's Labeling System Keeps Operations Running
item.description: Looking to reduce downtime caused by cleaning, maintenance and startup, as well as improve print consistency across its lines, the confectioner turned to Leibinger for a more reliable solution.

item.title: Laird Superfood Launches Coffee with Dairy-Based Protein
item.description: The move into dairy marks a new step for the brand and meets consumer demand for clean, dairy-based protein.

item.title: BRIDOR to Double Capacity at New Jersey Manufacturing Facility
item.description: The Vineland expansion project, which broke ground in the fall 2024, included the construction of a 51,000-sq.-ft. building to house a newly acquired Viennese pastry production line, as well as the installation of an industrial refrigeration system.

item.title: Charcuterie Artisans Opens Innovation Center in Rhode Island
item.description: With capacity available across manufacturing locations in Rhode Island, Iowa and Utah and the Innovation Center open, Charcuterie Artisans is actively seeking partners ready to capitalize on the category’s momentum.

item.title: Boh Bah Inc Opens Production Facility in Missouri
item.description: The company has opened a 50,000-sq.-ft., FDA-registered production facility in Mount Vernon, Missouri.
